title: The Turned Gear
subtitle: rotation: 45, and a stream at medium density
description: One gear of the train, turned a quarter-eighth: `rotation: 45`, any
shape turned to any angle, the outline fitted to the node with one
uniform scale so nothing is cut off and nothing is stretched. A
full turn is written as 0, because it is the same shape.
Its line runs a `stream` at `arrowDensity: medium` -- thirty-two
pixels between heads -- which completes the set: high on the comet,
medium here, low on the frame.
